data: Which of these morphs has the lowest average morphological complexity?

The question asks for the morph with the lowest average morphological complexity. From the analysis of the figure, the bars represent different morphs, and their lengths correspond to their average morphological complexity. The shorter the bar, the lower the average morphological complexity. Observing the figure, the "-ing" morph has the shortest bar among all the morphs shown. Therefore, the "-ing" morph has the lowest average morphological complexity.
